examples.en: Our overlap is only two hours a day, so we keep meetings for decisions only.
examples.zh: 我们每天只有两小时重叠时间，所以会议只用来做决策。

situation.en: We have about three hours of overlap — let's put the design review there.
situation.zh: 你和海外同事商量把评审放在重叠时段。

entries.zh: 工作时间重叠（跨时区协作的关键概念）

examples.en: I'll leave my notes in the doc so the US team can pick it up in their morning.
examples.zh: 我会把笔记留在文档里，美国团队早上就能接上。

situation.en: Just drop your update in the doc and I'll pick it up tomorrow.
situation.zh: 你告诉同事异步交接的方式：写进文档就行。

entries.zh: 接上、继续处理（在对方时区开始工作时）

examples.en: Let me record a quick walkthrough instead of scheduling a call across time zones.
examples.zh: 我录一段讲解视频吧，省得跨时区约电话了。

situation.en: I recorded a five-minute walkthrough of the failing flow — link in the ticket.
situation.zh: 你跟同事说你录了讲解，链接在工单里。

entries.zh: 录一段快速讲解（视频）

examples.en: Please keep the discussion in the ticket, not in private messages — future us will thank you.
examples.zh: 请把讨论留在工单里，别用私聊，未来的我们会感谢你的。

situation.en: Let's keep the discussion in the ticket so it's searchable later.
situation.zh: 有人想转去私聊，你想把讨论留痕。

entries.term: keep the discussion in the ticket
entries.zh: 把讨论留在工单/文档里（别转私聊）

examples.en: He's offline now — it's 2 a.m. his time. He'll see it when he's back online.
examples.zh: 他现在离线，他那边凌晨两点了。他上线时会看到的。

situation.en: He'll see it when he's back online — no need to wait up for a reply.
situation.zh: 你提醒大家对方今天已经下线了。

entries.term: He'll see it when he's back online.
entries.zh: 他上线时会看到的（异步预期管理）

examples.en: No need to reply right away — this is not urgent, just flagging it.
examples.zh: 不用马上回，不急，只是同步一下。

situation.en: No need to reply right away, just wanted it on your radar.
situation.zh: 你给对方发了个消息加上这句，免得他有压力。

entries.term: No need to reply right away.
entries.zh: 不用马上回复（异步礼仪神句）

examples.en: Just flagging this early so it doesn't surprise anyone in the review.
examples.zh: 我提前同步一下，免得评审时大家措手不及。

situation.en: Just flagging that the timeline might slip — details in the doc.
situation.zh: 你在频道里提前预警时间可能延期。

entries.zh: 只是提前同步一下（预警开场白）

examples.en: I'll write this up in the doc so everyone can read it in their own time zone.
examples.zh: 我会把这个写进文档，方便大家各自在自己的时区看。

situation.en: Rather than another meeting, I'll write it up tonight.
situation.zh: 你提议用文档代替再开一次会。

entries.term: write this up in the doc
entries.zh: 把这件事写成文档（同步给大家）

examples.en: Could you leave your comments on the doc by Thursday your time?
examples.zh: 你能在你那边的周四之前把评论留在文档上吗？

situation.en: Comments by Wednesday your time would be perfect.
situation.zh: 约评论截止时间时，你特意点明用对方的时区。

entries.zh: 按你的时区在周四前（跨时区说截止时间的说法）

examples.en: Let's move this to async — drop your thoughts in the doc and we'll decide tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我们转异步吧，把想法写在文档里，明天再定。

situation.en: This thread is getting long; let's move it to async in the doc.
situation.zh: 频道里讨论太长了，你提议转成文档异步讨论。

entries.zh: 把这件事转成异步（别开会了）

examples.en: Working async means writing things down as if the reader is asleep — because they probably are.
examples.zh: 异步协作意味着把事情写清楚到读者像睡着了一样——因为他们可能真的在睡觉。

entries.note: 这句是远程文化的名言式表达：异步写作要自带完整上下文，不能指望对方追问。

situation.en: Rule of thumb for our team: write it as if the reader is asleep.
situation.zh: 你在入职指南里写异步写作的原则。

entries.term: as if the reader is asleep
entries.zh: （写作时）假设读者在睡觉（自带上下文的异步原则）

examples.en: I left a comment on line forty-two explaining why the check has to happen before the write.
examples.zh: 我在第四十二行留了条评论，解释了为什么检查必须在写之前做。

situation.en: I left a few comments on the doc — mostly questions, not blockers.
situation.zh: 你通知同事文档上有你的评论。

entries.term: leave a comment on the doc
entries.zh: 在文档上留评论

examples.en: Please resolve the thread once you've addressed it, so I know it's done.
examples.zh: 处理完了请把讨论串标记为已解决，我就知道完事了。

situation.en: Please resolve the thread once you've addressed it — the doc is getting hard to read.
situation.zh: 文档评论太多，你请同事把处理完的折叠掉。

entries.term: Please resolve the thread once you've addressed it.
entries.zh: 处理完请把讨论标记为已解决

examples.en: Let me tag you in the doc where your input is needed.
examples.zh: 我会在文档里需要你意见的地方艾特你。

situation.en: I'll tag the right people in the thread.
situation.zh: 你答应把相关的人拉进讨论。

entries.zh: 在文档里艾特你

examples.en: I'll summarize the thread for anyone who doesn't want to read forty messages.
examples.zh: 我来总结一下这个讨论串，省得大家看四十条消息。

situation.en: Quick summary for the thread: we agreed on option B, rollout starts Monday.
situation.zh: 长讨论后你主动在串里发总结。

entries.zh: 把讨论串总结一下（异步好习惯）

examples.en: That's EOD for me — I'll hand this over to the Berlin team now.
examples.zh: 我这边今天到此为止了，我把这个交接给柏林团队。

situation.en: That's EOD for me — handover notes are in the ticket.
situation.zh: 下班前你在频道里交接。

entries.zh: 我这边今天结束了（EOD = end of day）

examples.en: I'll hand over the incident to the next shift with a written summary.
examples.zh: 我会用书面总结把这个故障交接给下一班。

situation.en: Let me write the handover before I log off.
situation.zh: 值班交接前你说先把交接文档写好。

entries.term: hand over to the next shift
entries.zh: 交接给下一班（跨时区接力）

examples.en: Can we make this meeting optional and record it for the Asia team?
examples.zh: 这个会能改成可选参加、并录下来给亚洲团队看吗？

situation.en: I'll record it for anyone who can't join live.
situation.zh: 你宣布会议会录像照顾其他时区。

entries.zh: 把（会议）录下来给……团队看

examples.en: The decision is documented in the RFC, in case anyone wonders later why we did this.
examples.zh: 这个决策记录在 RFC 里了，免得以后有人问当初为什么这么定。

situation.en: It'll be documented in the RFC, not just in meeting memory.
situation.zh: 你强调决策要落文档不能靠记忆。

entries.zh: 记录在 RFC 文档里（决策留痕）

examples.en: Let's not block on this — I'll proceed with option A unless someone objects by Friday.
examples.zh: 别卡在这了，我按方案 A 推进，除非有人在周五前反对。

entries.note: 这是远程团队的名技法：懒共识（lazy consensus）——给明确的截止时间，沉默视为同意。

situation.en: I'll proceed unless someone objects by tomorrow noon.
situation.zh: 群里没人回应你的方案，你给出默认推进法。

entries.zh: 除非有人在……之前反对（默认推进法）

examples.en: Heads up: the freeze starts Friday, so land your changes before then.
examples.zh: 提前说一声：周五开始封版，要合并的改动赶在那之前。

situation.en: Heads up — the staging database resets tonight.
situation.zh: 你提前给团队打预防针。

entries.zh: 提前说一声、提醒一下（开场）

examples.en: Please react with an emoji once you've read it, so I know it landed.
examples.zh: 看完了请用表情回复一下，我就知道传达到了。

situation.en: Please react with an emoji once you've read it — a check mark works.
situation.zh: 你设计了一个轻量签到机制。

entries.term: react with an emoji once you've read it
entries.zh: 看完用表情回复一下（已读确认）

examples.en: Her status says she's in focus time until three — don't expect a reply.
examples.zh: 她的状态显示三点前是专注时间，别指望回复。

situation.en: My status will show focus time during the migration.
situation.zh: 你提前说明深度工作期间状态会显示专注中。

entries.zh: 在专注时间（勿扰状态）

examples.en: Set your working hours in the calendar so people stop booking your evenings.
examples.zh: 在日历里设好工作时间，大家就不会老订你的晚上了。

situation.en: My working hours are in my profile — meetings outside them need a ping first.
situation.zh: 你在个人说明里写了工作时间规则。

entries.zh: 设置（日历里的）工作时间

examples.en: The whole retro is async this month — add your notes to the board by Wednesday.
examples.zh: 这个月的复盘全改成异步，周三前把笔记加到看板上。

situation.en: Retro is async this time; the board is open until Friday.
situation.zh: 你宣布本月复盘改为异步进行。

entries.zh: 异步复盘（不开会、看板留言）

examples.en: I recorded a Loom walking through the new flow — it's linked in the ticket.
examples.zh: 我录了一段 Loom 讲解新流程，链接在工单里。

entries.note: Loom 是最常见的异步录屏工具，很多远程团队把它当动词用：I'll Loom it. 我录个屏说明。

situation.en: Rather than a call, I'll Loom the demo for you.
situation.zh: 你提议录屏代替开会演示。

entries.zh: 一段 Loom 录屏讲解

examples.en: Time zones are the tax you pay for a global team — documentation is how you pay less of it.
examples.zh: 时区是全球团队要交的税，文档就是少交税的方法。

entries.note: 这句适合写在远程协作指南的开头，也是面试聊远程经验时的好句子。

situation.en: Remember: time zones are the tax you pay for a global team, and good docs are the discount.
situation.zh: 面试聊到远程协作的挑战，你给一个精辟总结。

entries.term: the tax you pay for a global team
entries.zh: 全球团队要付的“税”（比喻时区成本）

examples.en: Can we find a time that isn't midnight for anyone?
examples.zh: 我们能找一个对谁来说都不是半夜的时间吗？

situation.en: Let's pick a time that isn't midnight for anyone this time.
situation.zh: 约全球会议时你提议轮换时间、轮流吃亏。

entries.term: a time that isn't midnight for anyone
entries.zh: 一个对谁都不是半夜的时间

examples.en: Let's rotate who takes the late slot, so it's not always the same people suffering.
examples.zh: 我们轮换谁上晚班时段，别老是同一批人受罪。

situation.en: We'll rotate who takes the late slot every month, so it's fair.
situation.zh: 你宣布会议时间每月轮换一次。

entries.term: rotate who takes the late slot
entries.zh: 轮换谁来上晚班时段（公平原则）

examples.en: Sorry for the delay — your message landed in my evening, I only saw it this morning.
examples.zh: 抱歉回复晚了，你的消息到我这边时是晚上，我今早才看到。

situation.en: Apologies for the late reply — time zones.
situation.zh: 你为回复慢向对方简单解释时区原因。

entries.term: Sorry for the delay — time zones.
entries.zh: 抱歉回复晚了，时区原因

examples.en: I'll be OOO next week with no email access.
examples.zh: 我下周休假外出，不看邮件。

entries.note: OOO 是 out of office 的缩写，远程团队日历和状态里到处都是：OOO until Monday。

situation.en: Just so you know, I'll be OOO next week.
situation.zh: 你提前预警评审会慢：好多人休假。

entries.zh: 我下周不在（OOO = out of office）

examples.en: Just a friendly nudge on the review — no rush, today if you can.
examples.zh: 友情提醒一下评审的事，不急，今天能看就最好。

situation.en: Friendly nudge on the doc comments when you get a chance.
situation.zh: 你想催一下又不想显得逼人。

entries.zh: 友情提醒一下（催人神器）

examples.en: Blocking you is the last thing I want — ping me the moment you're stuck.
examples.zh: 我最不想的就是卡住你，你一卡住马上戳我。

situation.en: Blocking you is the last thing I want — escalate if it ever happens.
situation.zh: 你对新人说被你卡住时要升级、别干等。

entries.term: blocking you is the last thing I want
entries.zh: 我最不想的就是拖住你

examples.en: Let's default to writing it down — if it's not written, it didn't happen.
examples.zh: 我们默认一切落字：没写下来的，就算没发生。

entries.note: 远程文化的核心信条之一，出自 GitLab 的公开手册，面试聊远程协作时引用很加分。

situation.en: Our rule: if it's not written, it didn't happen.
situation.zh: 你向新人介绍团队的文档文化。

entries.term: if it's not written, it didn't happen
entries.zh: 没写下来就等于没发生（文档文化信条）

examples.en: The stand-up is a written update now — post yours before ten your time.
examples.zh: 站会改成书面更新了，在你那边十点前发出来。

situation.en: Written stand-ups start Monday; template is in the channel.
situation.zh: 你宣布站会改成书面形式。

entries.zh: 书面更新（代替开会）

examples.en: I'll catch up on the thread when I'm back at my desk.
examples.zh: 我回到工位时会把这个讨论串补看完。

situation.en: Twenty messages behind — I'll catch up tonight.
situation.zh: 你发现讨论串落后了二十条，说晚上补上。

entries.zh: 把讨论串补看完

examples.en: Please keep PR descriptions self-explanatory — reviewers may be asleep in another time zone.
examples.zh: PR 描述请写得自解释，评审的人可能正在另一个时区睡觉。

situation.en: Keep it self-explanatory — assume the reader has zero context.
situation.zh: 你给团队讲 PR 描述的写作标准。

entries.zh: 自带解释的、无需追问就能懂的

examples.en: One more async tip: ask your question in public channels, so the answer helps everyone.
examples.zh: 再一个异步小技巧：问题问在公开频道，答案能帮到所有人。

situation.en: Ask in the channel, not in DMs — others probably have the same question.
situation.zh: 有人私聊你问题，你引导他去公开频道问。

entries.zh: 在公开频道提问（别私聊）
